correctness.rationale: I independently checked exact 2×2 matrices K=diag(1,0), U=[[0,1],[0,0]], W=H, Λ=K, C=C’=I. E(f)=|f1|²=||K*f||², R(U)=R(K)=span e1, U*f=(0,f1), and ||U*f||=||K*f||. However UW=span e1 and ΛU*P_UW=0 identically, contradicting any positive K-lower frame bound at e1. Theorem 2.3 at publisher pp114–115 imposes no injectivity of U. For closed-range K, (K†)*K*=P_R(K), not identity; applying it to U*f requires R(U*)⊆R(K). The published sufficient-bound algebra follows with the added range hypothesis if image fusion spaces are closed. The false theorem’s necessary half was not refuted.

value.rationale: A formally stated iff transport criterion for controlled K-g-fusion frames fails even with equality in its numerical condition and with closed image subspace. The constructive failure isolates a meaningful hidden adjoint-range condition affecting usable operator-transfer criteria, not a cosmetic constant or textbook renaming.

final_claim: Theorem 2.3 of Rahimlou–Sadri–Ahmadi (2020) has a false converse: a specific rank-one C² operator satisfies all stated hypotheses and the norm criterion but its transformed controlled K-g-fusion analysis has zero energy. R(U*)⊆R(K) suffices to validate the defective pseudo-inverse conversion, with closed image subspaces.
